description: This Java class 'DefaultTbImageService' implements image resource management functionalities for Thingsboard, including caching, saving, deleting, and importing images, with cache eviction and access control.

classes.name: DefaultTbImageService
classes.description: Service class for managing images, including caching, saving, deleting, and importing images with cache eviction and access control.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for a given image cache key from cache.

methods.name: putETag
methods.description: Stores the ETag for a given image cache key into cache.

methods.name: evictETags
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a given image cache key.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an image resource, manages cache eviction based on ETag changes.

methods.name: getEtag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from an image resource's descriptor.

methods.name: getPreviewEtag
methods.description: Extracts the preview ETag from an image resource's descriptor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves image info, updates cache if public status changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an image resource and evicts related cache entries.

methods.name: importImage
methods.description: Imports an image resource with permission checks.

methods.name: evictFromCache
methods.description: Broadcasts cache invalidation to core services and evicts cache entries.
